# Tuteliq .NET SDK

> Official .NET SDK for Tuteliq — AI-powered child safety API for C#/.NET applications.

## What is this?
A .NET library for the Tuteliq child safety API. Detect bullying, grooming, self-harm, substance promotion, and other harmful content in text, conversations, audio, images, and video. Works with ASP.NET, Blazor, MAUI, and any .NET 6+ application.

## Install
dotnet add package Tuteliq

## Quick Start
using Tuteliq;
var client = new TuteliqClient(apiKey: Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("TUTELIQ_API_KEY"));
var result = await client.DetectUnsafeAsync(text: "content to check", ageGroup: "13-15");

## Key Features
- Async/await throughout
- All 20+ Tuteliq API endpoints
- 16+ detection categories (KOSA compliant)
- Age group calibration (under-10, 10-12, 13-15, 14-17)
- Automatic retries and error handling
- Strong typing for all request/response models
- Age Verification (Beta) — POST /v1/verification/age — Pro tier ($99/mo)+, 5 credits
- Identity Verification (Beta) — POST /v1/verification/identity — Business tier ($349/mo)+, 10 credits
